new_source_issue.title: Acquire complete Yu2012 biogenic-birnessite cobalt evidence before curation
new_source_issue.body:
The round41 source investigation verified a separately scoped 2008 study (DOI 10.2320/matertrans.M-MRA2007888), which is being added to the existing birnessite record. It did not obtain the complete Yu et al. 2012 article, DOI 10.1016/j.chemgeo.2012.03.029, and does not support importing that paper’s quantitative or mechanistic claims.

Evidence recovered on 2026-10-12 UTC:

- Publisher/Crossref identity and abstract; the public Elsevier response is only coredata metadata despite its full-text wrapper.
- JAEA record 5035603 has metadata/abstract but no PDF in its PDF field.
- Kyushu catalogue 26198 reports deleted data; the indexed download is a 108-page thesis-summary compilation, with Yu on pages 68–69, not the complete thesis.
- KEK PF News 31(2), August 2013, page 44 contains an author summary and one Co XANES comparison, but not complete experimental methods and controls.

Follow-up acceptance criteria:

1. Acquire the complete primary article and original figures, tables and relevant supplements through a legitimate library, author-deposited or institutional route; retain version, URL and hashes.
2. Verify fungal strain, biomass state, material preparation, cobalt loading, conditions, controls and the analytical basis for oxidation or incorporation claims.
3. Establish its experiment/preparation relationship to the 2008 paper before combining observations or claiming independent replication.
4. Curate only supported additional claims in the existing material owner, append history and save a new independent scientific review. Otherwise retain a documented deferral.

This is an evidence-access follow-up, not a corrective defect in the qualified 2008 record. Do not close it when round41 merges. The round41 dossier will be linked after publication; it currently resides at research/sources/round41-biogenic-birnessite/20261012T012315Z-source-investigation.md.

progress_issue134.body:
Round41 follow-up found a legitimate additional source: the 2025 SPbU-hosted coauthor review at https://pureportal.spbu.ru/files/132149284/xk5108.pdf. Its original Figure 7 reproduces six SEM panels from the 2022 study by permission; these panels were visually inspected. A separate 69-page project report at https://pureportal.spbu.ru/files/91305371/_2019_2021.pdf was also acquired.

These additions do not recover the original main PXRD/control series needed to resolve the experimental assignment in DOI 10.2138/am-2021-7651. Issue #134 remains open. Round41 separately establishes todorokite and kutnohorite mineral identities from dated IMA and complete Handbook authorities; those identity-only records do not assert the deferred microbial experiment or resolve this source gap. The source assessment is research/sources/round41-manganese-minerals/20261012T012222Z-source-investigation.md, to be linked after publication.
